name: WdCompatibilityMode
description: Specifies the compatibility mode that Word uses when opening a document.

constants.name: wdWord2003
constants.description: Word is put into a mode that is most compatible with Word 2003. Features new to Word are disabled in this mode.

constants.name: wdWord2007
constants.description: Word is put into a mode that is most compatible with Word 2007. Features new to Word are disabled in this mode.

constants.name: wdWord2010
constants.description: Word is put into a mode that is most compatible with Word 2010. Features new to Word are disabled in this mode.

constants.name: wdWord2013
constants.description: Default. All Word features are enabled.

constants.name: wdCurrent
constants.description: Compatibility mode equivalent to the latest version of Word.
